title: Rank-zero and rank-one Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer theory, Part II: CM rank-zero converses and twist nonvanishing
summary: This Part II of RankZeroOneBSD plans the all-prime rank-zero converse for CM newforms and CM elliptic curves, and its twist-nonvanishing applications. The proof passes through rational Poitou–Tate, central cyclotomic specialization, the actual Beilinson–Kato class and reciprocity. Completed coefficient and dyadic conventions are explicit. The congruent-number application has an exact half-density after an ordering comparison; the CM twist and non-descent applications have lower proportion at least one half.
readme: The reader document research/blueprint/readmes/CMRankZeroConverse.md is the full specification. This Part II of RankZeroOneBSD plans the all-prime rank-zero converse for CM newforms and CM elliptic curves, and its twist-nonvanishing applications. The proof passes through rational Poitou–Tate, central cyclotomic specialization, the actual Beilinson–Kato class and reciprocity. Completed coefficient and dyadic conventions are explicit. The congruent-number application has an exact half-density after an ordering comparison; the CM twist and non-descent applications have lower proportion at least one half. The roadmap owns the shared rank-r p-converse proposition but proves it only for rank zero and CM. It imports all actual L-functions, continuous Selmer/cohomology carriers, main-conjecture inputs and statistical distributions from their owners. Sources are stated in our own words with version-specific locators. No integral BSD valuation, unrestricted converse or positive-density assertion in the cube-sum parameter is planned. All seven layers are planned, not closed; pending supplier registration is recorded as GAP-CM and GAP-SMITH.

stages.title: Central conventions and shared propositions
stages.description: Define the shared rank-r p-converse implication, the correctly normalized central sign, the central specialization kernel σ_c↦c^(−k/2), and the cohomological/conjugate-dual dictionary. The newform, Selmer, completed-algebra and analytic-rank carriers are imports.

stages.title: Finite-level vanishing and the global line
stages.description: For every even weight k≥2 and every λ|p, prove global H⁰ vanishing, H¹_f(ℚ,W)=0 ⇒ H²(Z[1/p],j_*T(h))[1/p]=0 using both Tate-dual applications of rational Poitou–Tate, then the one-dimensional global H¹ theorem. Prove central H_g=H_f, including bad p, by excluding crystalline eigenvalue one on W^∨(1).

stages.title: Central specialization of the Kato class
stages.description: Apply imported derived control at the central character, keeping the degree-one and degree-two Tor terms until amplitude and H² vanishing remove them. Define the actual twist-specialized Kato class, prove the correctly signed class spans the global line assuming rational Kato equality, and show its p-localization is not finite.

stages.title: The rational rank-zero newform converse
stages.description: Use the actual Kato reciprocity formula, with f*, the critical period sign and the p-omitted Euler factor, to deduce central nonvanishing. State the non-CM result conditionally on rational Kato equality. Obtain the all-prime CM newform result from the separately owned CM equality; GAP-CM records its absent registered endpoint.

stages.title: CM elliptic curves and quadratic descent
stages.description: Use completed coefficients, CM idempotents, weight-two theta induction and finite-condition Shapiro to prove CM Selmer vanishing implies modular Selmer vanishing for E/K with arbitrary CM order. Deduce BT Theorem 1.1 over K for every p. Prove rational corank and analytic-order doubling for E/ℚ, retaining dyadic integral errors before rationalization, and deduce pConverse(E,p,0).

stages.title: Congruent-number twists and even Goldfeld
stages.description: Define the even Goldfeld proposition using both-sign fundamental discriminants ordered by absolute value. Combine the unconditional Smith positive-family corank input (GAP-SMITH pending registration) with the CM 2-converse to obtain density one in positive squarefree residues 1,2,3 mod 8. Use the sign obstruction for an exact half-density among positive squarefree parameters and prove its piecewise-height transfer to fundamental discriminants.

stages.title: CM twists, cube sums and non-descent
stages.description: Combine the imported BKLOS corank-zero lower bound and the all-prime CM 3-converse for imaginary quadratic K where 3 is split or ramified, using the precise unweighted odd-valuation support height. Define and check the cube-sum Weierstrass model for each n≠0 and its j=0 CM action. Prove descending parameters lie in at most two rational-squareclass cosets, their O(√X) count and density zero, then retain lower nonvanishing proportion at least 1/2 among non-descending twists.
